name: mcp-agent-bridge
description: Unified MCP gateway — discover and execute tools across multiple child servers (hosting, PC control, AI image/video, browser automation).

interface.shortDescription: Dynamic MCP gateway for hosting, PC, AI generation, and browser tools.
interface.longDescription: A unified MCP server bridge that aggregates multiple child servers. Use bridge__list_servers to discover available servers, bridge__list_server_tools for tool schemas, and bridge__execute to run any tool.
